verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent API spec, and a probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt index, the JSON Lines event stream and the user-supplied JSON Schema output mode are related machine-readable features, but none of them is a published API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
